summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Perusahaan Perseroan (Persero) PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk, a state-owned Indonesian telecom company, for the month of May 2026. The filing contains the company's 2025 Sustainability Report, which discusses business transformation, ESG initiatives, climate change management, diversity, and governance. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation events. The filing is a routine sustainability report submission by a foreign private issuer and does not trigger any of the special-situations categories. Therefore, it is classified as None.
